title: Share of boys enrolled in upper secondary school
subtitle: Comparing [net](#dod:net-enrollment-ratio) and [gross enrollment ratios](#dod:gross-enrolment-ratio) for boys in [upper secondary](#dod:upper-secondary-education) education. Net enrollment shows the share of boys of upper secondary school age (between 15 and 18 years old) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment includes all boys regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of boys of the same age group.
